title: Consider a recovery-day substitution
body: Synthetic example only: consider replacing Wednesday's hard session with an easy recovery ride. The rider has not approved or applied this change.
rationale: Keep an unresolved coaching option available for the next conversation without changing the official plan.
conditions: Review current recovery and the upcoming priority event before deciding.
Applying the change requires separate explicit approval.
